title: Medical Record
description: One digitised medical document (prescription, lab report, discharge summary, or other) extracted into a structured, consistent shape. See PROJECT_SPEC.md section 8. Unreadable fields are null, never guessed and never the string 'N/A'. Dates are normalised to YYYY-MM-DD.

record_id.description: Stable unique id for this record.

episode_id.description: Links documents from the same visit or condition into one episode. Null until clustered.

source_filename.description: Filename of the original uploaded document, which is retained locally as the source of truth.

date_processed.description: Date this record was processed, YYYY-MM-DD.

record_date.description: Date on the document itself, YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not readable; never guessed.

stated_text.description: The diagnosis exactly as written on the document. Null if none is stated.

plain_language.description: Plain-language reading of what is written. General facts about a named condition are allowed; claims about this patient (severity, cause, prognosis, what to do) are not.

medications.description: One entry per medication. Empty array if none.

purpose_plain.description: Plain-language purpose. General facts about a named drug are allowed; claims about this patient are not.

investigations.description: One entry per test or measurement. Empty array if none.

flag.description: Carried only when a flag is printed on the source report. Never computed from value and reference range. Use 'unknown' when no flag is printed.

plain_note.description: Plain-language reading of what is written. No assessment of what the value means for this patient.

advice_verbatim.description: Advice or instructions exactly as written on the document. Not paraphrased or extended.

follow_up.description: Follow-up instruction as written. Null if none.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence in the extraction.

flags.description: Machine-readable reasons this record may need review (for example, 'low_confidence', 'unreadable_dose').

needs_review.description: Set deterministically by validate.py from real signals, not by the model.
